posts.summary: Illustrated passport map and Z-fold event piece.
posts.content:
Taste & Tour is an annual Parents Club of West Point event. The 2018 event featured the Passport to the Hudson River, a custom-designed map and promotional piece highlighting participating local businesses.

The complete visual design and layout for the Passport included the illustrated map, business listings, advertising spaces and sponsor placements. Coordination with PCWP, the event planner and participating local businesses ensured that business locations and advertising were organized according to sponsorship level and incorporated into the map and overall design.

The project was developed using Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop and InDesign, including the map illustration, graphic elements, typography, advertising layouts and print-ready production files. The finished piece was designed as a Z-fold so that, when folded, it resembled a passport.

Physical print production included printing and machine-folding the finished pieces.
